nl: Write the relative paths of all .tsx files in src/ (recursively) to components.txt, one path per line, sorted, with '/' as separator and without a leading './'.
oracle_program: find "src" glob: "**/*.tsx" type: file sort: name |> select relative |> write "components.txt" format: lines
reference_bash: find src -type f -name '*.tsx' | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort > components.txt
